title: 第5章 结算第6章 现实中
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: 朦胧中，齐格飞看到了无数虚幻的光影在自己眼前扭曲跳动，像是在风中窜动的篝火。
老村长，小托娃，黄毛士兵，卡塔丽娜……
一个又一个的人影闪现而过。
恬静祥和的村庄，于春风中摇曳的碧绿麦浪，村民们淳朴的笑脸，凶狠的唾骂，挥舞而来的长矛，万里的晴空之下，女骑士挎着白马昂扬的银白头盔……
神秘的漫游手册，寒光闪烁的朴素长剑，男人的阴鸷森冷的五官，最后定格在他持剑冲向女骑士的画面。
齐格飞慢慢睁开双眼，映入眼帘的是熟悉的天花板。
书桌，电脑，衣柜，懒人椅，单人床，简洁朴素到没有一丝花哨的房间。
没错，是自己的卧室。
一切宛若南柯一梦。
“回来了……我在做梦？”
齐格飞难以置信的喃喃自语，他甚至有些怀疑在风桃村经历的七天会不会只是一个漫长的梦境。
“夏侬？”
他试探着呼喊道，然而脑海里那个空灵的声音并没有回应他。
“……真的是梦。”
一种不知源头的寂寥感突然包围了齐格飞，他的眼神的都黯淡了下来。
【我在。】
“卧槽！”
齐格飞差点从床上摔下来。
“叮呢？叮呢？你一般开口前不都会叮一下提示的吗？”
史官夏侬平静空灵的声音在脑海中回响：
【那只是模仿网络小说中的系统，既然您已经签订了契约我也就没必要继续做那种愚蠢的事了。】
“啊这……”齐格飞听得瞠目结舌。
【漫游者先生，你的新手任务已完成，请打开漫游手册领取你的奖励。】
齐格飞眉头一跳，当即召唤出漫游手册有些兴奋地翻阅起来。
“先开罐子吧，我最喜欢抽奖了。”
他迫不及待地把物品栏那一页多出来的两个黑色的土瓦罐取了出来。
历史故事罐子（仅完成阶段任务可获得）
类别：消耗品
品质：看你运气
欲知大道，必先为史。历史是所有知识的浓缩，是一切智慧的结晶。这个罐子中包含着万千世界历史的一切，砸开它能获得一件存在于幻想中的事物。
备注一：罐子里更容易出现您了解的事物。
备注二：现在您知道我们为什么叫【史官】了吗？
“这是啥都能抽出来的意思？”
齐格飞脸颊有些抽搐，他虽然有着b级的幸运，但对这种不定向全随机抽奖还是心里没底。
（呼，既然啥都能出，那就来个白金之星！）
他抱起第一个土瓦罐轻轻一捏，罐子龟裂，碎片洒落开来，一团柔和的白光漂浮在空中，收缩又膨胀着。
“哦！！真的是白的！”
“白的啊……”
光团落到齐格飞手中，那是用一团用粉色塑料袋包装起来的棉布，捏起来柔顺无比，上面写着两个醒目蓝色字体，
苏菲。
content_en:
In the haze, Siegfried saw countless illusory lights and shadows twisting and dancing in front of his eyes, like bonfires blowing in the wind.
The old village chief, Little Towa, the yellow-haired soldier, Katarina...
One figure after another flashed past.
The quiet and peaceful village, the waves of green wheat swaying in the spring breeze, the simple smiling faces of the villagers, the ferocious curses, the waving spears, under the clear sky thousands of miles away, the female knight carrying a white horse with a high-spirited silver helmet...
The mysterious roaming manual, the simple long sword with cold light, the man's sinister and cold facial features, and finally the scene of him charging towards the female knight with the sword.
Siegfried slowly opened his eyes, and what he saw was the familiar ceiling.
Desk, computer, wardrobe, lazy chair, single bed, a simple and simple room without any fancy.
That's right, it's your own bedroom.
Everything is like a dream.
"I'm back...am I dreaming?"
Siegfried murmured to himself in disbelief. He even doubted whether the seven days he experienced in Fengtao Village were just a long dream.
"Shannon?"
He tentatively called out, but the disembodied voice in his mind did not respond to him.
"...It's really a dream."
A sense of loneliness of unknown origin suddenly surrounded Siegfried, and his eyes dimmed.
【I am here. 】
"Fuck!"
Siegfried almost fell off the bed.
"What about ding? What about ding? Don't you usually ding as a reminder before you speak?"
Historian Shannon's calm and ethereal voice echoed in my mind:
[That is just an imitation of the system in online novels. Now that you have signed the contract, there is no need for me to continue doing such stupid things. 】
"Ah this..." Siegfried was dumbfounded.
[Mr. Wanderer, your novice mission has been completed. Please open the Wanderer Manual to claim your reward. 】
Siegfried's brows jumped, and he immediately summoned the Hitchhiker's Manual and started flipping through it excitedly.
"Open the jar first, I like the lottery the most."
He couldn't wait to take out the two extra black earthenware jars on the inventory page.
Historical story jar (can only be obtained by completing stage tasks)
Category: Consumables
Quality: depends on your luck
If you want to know the great road, you must first study history. History is the concentration of all knowledge and the crystallization of all wisdom. This jar contains everything in the history of thousands of worlds. Break it open to get something that exists in fantasy.
Note 1: Jars are more likely to contain things you know.
Note 2: Now do you know why we are called [Historian]?
"Does this mean you can pull out anything?"
Siegfried's cheeks twitched a little. Although he had B-level luck, he was still unsure about this kind of non-directional random lottery.
(Phew, since you can do anything, let’s get a Platinum Star!)
He picked up the first clay jar and squeezed it gently. The jar cracked and the pieces scattered. A soft white light floated in the air, shrinking and expanding.
"Oh!! It's really white!"
"..."
"It's white..."
The ball of light fell into Siegfried's hand. It was a ball of cotton wrapped in a pink plastic bag. It was very soft when pinched. There were two eye-catching blue fonts written on it,
Sophie.
"..."
